name: omp-cache-monitor
description: Cache hit-rate monitor and /cache-monitor command for OMP

omp.description: Prefix-cache hit rate, warnings, history and cost reports for OMP

preset.description: Preset · Value bundle for the other keys: balanced, quiet, verbose or custom. Default: balanced. An explicitly set key always beats the preset; custom applies no preset values and never changes language.

statusEnabled.description: Status · Show ↺ hit rate in the status line. Default: true. Turn off if another segment already reports cache.

statusShowMode.description: Status · Prefix the hit rate with OMP_MODE (cache-safe ↺ 98%). Default: true.

statusShowCost.description: Status · Publish the last turn cost as a separate segment ($0.0027) under cache-monitor-cost. Default: false. The hit line is unchanged; the segment appears after the first completed turn.

warningsEnabled.description: Warnings · Toast on cache misses. Default: true. Off = status and reports only.

lowHitPercent.description: Warnings · Warn when a turn's hit is below this percent. Default: 50; range 1–100.

idleMinutes.description: Warnings · Gaps of at least N minutes are reported as "простой". Default: 5. Empirical heuristic, not a provider TTL.

minPromptTokens.description: Warnings · Skip warnings for prompts smaller than N tokens. Default: 4000.

warnCanonicalMiss.description: Warnings · Toast on a canonical prefix miss. Default: true. Off keeps low-hit warnings.

minPrevPromptTokens.description: Warnings · Minimum previous-prompt tokens before a canonical-miss comparison. Default: 2048; range 0–1000000. Smaller prefixes are not compared.

oncePerEpoch.description: Warnings · Emit each warning kind once per prefix epoch. Default: true. false warns on every qualifying turn.

historySize.description: Reports · Turns kept by /cache-monitor history. Default: 8; range 1–50.

trendSize.description: Reports · Sparkline points kept live and after resume. Default: 12; range 1–50.

showMoney.description: Reports · Show saved / miss premium in dollars. Default: true. /cache-monitor costs always shows money.

language.description: Reports · Output language for command labels and warnings. Default: ru. Manifest descriptions stay English.
